shop_line.name: product.front / product-api

shop_line.name: Grafana (Monitoring)

shop_line.name: posselect-ui

shop_line.name: posselect-shell

mail.name: Self-hosted Mail (docker-mailserver)

infrastructure.name: kube-prometheus-stack (Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager)

infrastructure.name: Loki / Promtail
infrastructure.desc: Cluster-wide container log collection for all namespaces.

infrastructure.name: Velero (Backup Automation)
infrastructure.desc: Daily automated backup of PVC data based on MinIO.

cicd.name: self-hosted runner CD (Auto deployment)
cicd.scope: gateway / auth.api / store.front / customer.front / admin.front / order.api / product.api

issues: Security hardening not applied (RBAC granularity, NetworkPolicy, Istio mTLS — planned only)
Distributed tracing only measures 4 Java backends (Next.js frontends not measured), no Kiali/Service Mesh observability yet
Single point of failure (Single node cluster, no redundancy)
Alertmanager only integrated with Email, additional channels like Slack not integrated
Self-hosted mail server uses home dynamic IP+no PTR, potential spam folder delivery (Structural limit)
customer.front needs social login (Kakao/Naver/Google) and phone verification backend integration
Velero needs periodic (e.g. 3 months) recovery validation routine

domain_split.title: Domain Restructuring: Separation of leedohyun.com (Personal) / posselect.com (Shop) (2026-08-02)
domain_split.summary: Completed domain separation between leedohyun.com (Personal) and posselect.com (Shopping mall). K3s infrastructure is shared, but Auth/Routing/DNS layers are operated independently.
migrated_items: Route53: New posselect.com hosted zone and record separation
TLS: Dedicated wildcard certificate separation for posselect.com
Ingress: Separation of routing entry points by domain
Gateway: Domain independence secured through externalized security configs
Keycloak: Separation of shopping mall dedicated authentication server
Mail: Setup of dedicated mail server account for the shopping mall
domain_split.backward_compat: Legacy leedohyun.com based hosts redirect to posselect.com with 302 to maintain compatibility.

roadmap.desc: The current K3s single node system is a transitional infrastructure. We plan a large-scale expansion to a managed cloud infrastructure along with the introduction of VOD and live streaming as the shopping mall service traffic grows.
